content.short: Petra Wallet is the flagship self-custodial wallet for Aptos, designed by Aptos Labs for security and ease of use.
content.description: Petra Wallet is the definitive, self-custodial digital asset manager built natively for the Aptos blockchain by the expert team at Aptos Labs. Designed for a seamless and secure user experience, the wallet supports advanced features like social logins, biometric authentication, and deep integration with the Aptos dApp ecosystem. Users can manage tokens, trade NFTs, and interact with DeFi protocols within an intuitive interface. The wallet also features a built-in "Earn" section, enabling one-click participation in network staking and lending directly from the extension or app.
